text_block_list.text: —In early March, that news came flying in.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I, Verxina... will be running in this 
year's Victoria Mile."

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
An emergency press conference had me 
wondering what happened... I never 
expected an announcement like this!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
"I get to see it again...! Verxina's 
thrilling, heart-racing race!"

The former "Mile Queen," who had stepped 
back from the front lines in recent years, 
is making a comeback— That news took the 
world by storm.
And furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
In this year's Victoria Mile... your 
little sister, Vivlos, has also announced 
her entry! Which meansâ

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I chose this race in order to face my 
younger sister.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, you must be aware of how strong 
my little sister is right now. ...I have 
seen it for myself as well.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"—I've been watching over her growth... up 
close, the whole time."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
As an older sister... and as an Umamusume. 
My mind was already made up.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—Vivlos, my present to you is a thrilling 
race.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ――Big Sis!

Vivlos, who had been watching the press 
conference with me, rushed over to her 
sister's side the moment it ended.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you hear she's running in the 
Victoria Mile...?!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Just as I declared.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: But why?!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Oh? Do you dislike racing against me?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Nope, I'm super happy!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Because I've never run against you when 
you're truly serious, Big Sis!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Excited?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Super!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Then deciding to run was 
definitely the right call.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Verxina, you really worked so hard for 
my sake, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Still, because of that... my most 
important dream has drifted further away."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Then as an older sister... there was only 
one thing I had to do.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—I shall give you a race that fulfills 
your heart just as much as the races in 
Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big sis...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: “—Well then, shall we?”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: As everyone knows. I am strong.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of letting you take 
the spotlight. I've grown stronger than 
back then, and I'll meet you head-on.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I wonder... can you surpass me?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Heh. ...I expect great things from you.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, we're racing against Big Sis! 
Isn't that crazy!?

Upon hearing Verxina's declaration, Vivlos 
seemed to have completely regained her 
spirits.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm super happy! I mean, I'd never even 
thought of doing that!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
When we were kids, we used to run together 
a lot, but Big Sis was always holding 
back...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I was always the one chasing after her. 
Even after entering Tracen Academy, it was 
the same—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I used to watch Big Sis from outside the 
turf. Back then, that felt like the 
natural order of things...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
But... I can actually run with all my 
might against a big sister like that, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: It's okay for me to run, isn't it!

Seeing how thrilled Vivlos was, Verxina's 
feelings had clearly reached her. If so, 
then as a Triple Tiara Umamusume—
choice_data_list:
I'll stand in your way with everything 
I've got!
Let's enjoy this to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Hold on, I think I just came up with 
something crazy cool♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, hello, Big Sis? There's something 
I forgot to tell you earlier!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Um, you see...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Bring it oooon!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, since we get to race together! Bring 
on the sparks♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And then~... I also need to talk with my 
other big sister!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, aren't you provocative? And 
what's more—"
"Come at me whenever you're ready."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Using my own words against me. Good 
grief..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—Don't blame me if you end up regretting 
it.

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
""I, Verxina, will be running in this 
year's Victoria Mile.""

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm gonna have super-duper fun♪
choice_data_list:
If you can beat Verxina, you'll be super 
rich!

If you can beat Verxina, you'll be super 
rich!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: !! It really is~~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You're right, if I'm gonna do it... I'll 
become way more of a celebrity and go to 
Dubai!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
All right. I'll give it my all in the 
Victoria Mile!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, right. Before that...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
A race with big sis... I have to let that 
other person watch, too!

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
""I, Verxina, will be running in this 
year's Victoria Mile.""

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
“—With this, the dream sister showdown is 
realized! The Victoria Mile is shaping up 
to be more exciting than ever!”

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...A "sisterly" showdown, huh.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah, that's right. Someone like me 
who can't get results...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...! W-What is it?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if you'll come watch this year's 
Victoria Mile.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...If I go... I'll only feel more 
pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I know. Just how big the gap is between me 
and the two of them—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: No, Cheval. I am certain of it.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Our race is not meant to back you into a 
corner."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—It is something that sets your heart 
ablaze.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...? What do you mean...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I can tell just by looking. ...Hey, 
Chevalier, you're an important little 
sister to me, too.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: And—... No, I'll leave this to that girl.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'll be waiting for you at Tokyo 
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "...Sigh. What on earth was that—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —Chevalchiii!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Listen, listen! You'll definitely come 
watch the Victoria Mile, right?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ... Did my sister talk you into this?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "...No. I'm sorry, but I...—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: No excuses~! You HAVE to come!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You know, I'm going to race against my big 
sister. Against my super, super strong big 
sister!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I'm glad for you. Because you... love 
your sister so much.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That's why I want my other beloved 
big sister to come too!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
To my beloved, precious big sis! I want to 
show her!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...I was only able to do my best because 
I'm their little sister."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: That's why I want to... for Cheval-chi...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...I'll be waiting for you!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...How can both of you... say that so 
casually?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Cheval! Come here!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Cheva-chiii~~♡ I love you!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Even I...—
